note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording and the OT renderings made in its register: Owen's cited verses (Romans 8, Galatians 5, Colossians 3, Romans 6-7, Hebrews 2-4), the long recitations (Galatians 5:19-21, Psalm 78:32-37, Proverbs 30:2-4, Isaiah 40:27-31, Hebrews 2:17-18 and 4:15-16, Romans 6:1-6, Ephesians 5:25-27), and the phrases he quotes again inside his own sentences.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, the shortest span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. Where OWB opens an inner quotation inside a quotation, the inner marks are ‹ › (and ‘ ’ one level further in). `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, the author's own paraphrases and glosses of the Greek, and the few places where OWB's sense differs from the AV wording Owen argues from.

Judgement calls. Romans 8:13 'the deeds of the body' is OWB «የአካልን ልማዶች», so the duty is quoted as «የአካልን ልማዶች ዘወትር ብትገድሉ» throughout and Owen's word-study on 'body' follows OWB's «አካል»; Romans 6:6 'the body of sin' is «የኃጢአት አካል». 2 Corinthians 4:16 'inward man' is OWB «የውስጡ ማንነታችን», and the prose that plays on it follows. John 16:8 'convince' takes OWB «መሳሳቱን ያረጋግጣል» (decision convict); Acts 2:33 'the promise' is «ተስፋ» (decision the-promise); 1 Thessalonians 5:17 is «መጸለይን አታቋርጡ» (decision pray-without-ceasing). Owen's 'axe laid to the root' (Matthew 3:10, Luke 3:9) is OWB «መጥረቢያው … በዛፎቹ ሥር ላይ ተደግኗል», and his own retelling of John's words follows the same word. Five places keep the AV sense because OWB says something else (James 4:5, Matthew 12:33, Job 42:6, Matthew 17:21 / Mark 9:29 'and fasting', Deuteronomy 29:19); each row says why.
